oteni.name: Levy Spearmen
oteni.description: Village men with spears and wicker shields, called up by the prince. Cheap and steady.

arcasi.name: Archers
arcasi.description: Free peasants with hunting bows. They thin the enemy before the lines meet.

calareti.name: Noble Horsemen
calareti.description: The boyars' sons in mail, on their best horses. They hit hardest at the first clash.

vanatori.name: Monster Hunters
vanatori.description: Hunters of strigoi and zmei, armed with stakes, garlic and holy water.

tunari.name: Gunners
tunari.description: Town guildsmen with heavy hand-cannons from Brașov. Slow, loud and deadly.

pui_de_zmeu.name: Dragon Whelps
pui_de_zmeu.description: Young dragon-kin, half man, half wyrm. Tough hides and a hot temper.

zmei_buzdugan.name: Mace Drakes
zmei_buzdugan.description: Grown zmei who hurl their maces from afar before they close in, as in the old tales.

balauri.name: Three-Headed Wyrms
balauri.description: Three-headed dragons. They fly over walls and burn whatever stands behind them.

spiridusi.name: Imp Scouts
spiridusi.description: Small, quick imps who serve the zmei as scouts and thieves.

zmeul_mare.name: The Dragon Lord
zmeul_mare.description: The lord of the zmei himself. Wherever he fights, his kin strike harder.

iele_dansatoare.name: Dancing Fae
iele_dansatoare.description: Fairies of the clearings. Their round dance drives men mad and weakens their blows.

valve.name: Woodland Spirits
valve.description: Spirits of the old woods. Strongest in the first moments of an ambush among the trees.

sanziene.name: Midsummer Maidens
sanziene.description: The kind fairies of midsummer. They heal the wounded around them.

rusalii.name: Wrathful Sprites
rusalii.description: Wrathful spirits of Pentecost week. They charge in a frenzy.

muma_padurii.name: Mother of the Forest
muma_padurii.description: The Mother of the Forest, old as the oaks. The Fae take heart when she walks among them.

morti.name: Risen Dead
morti.description: The risen dead. Slow and weak, but they never run.

strigoi.name: Vampires
strigoi.description: Vampires who drink the strength of those they wound to heal their own.

moroi.name: Dread Wraiths
moroi.description: Pale wraiths. Living men lose their nerve when they come near.

varcolaci.name: Werewolves
varcolaci.description: Wolf-men of the full moon. Fast, and savage in the charge.

strigoi_batran.name: The Elder Vampire
strigoi_batran.description: The oldest of the strigoi, master of the Black Marsh. His dead fight on harder for him.

haiduc_voinici.name: Haiduc Braves
haiduc_voinici.description: Young men who left the plough for the greenwood. Deadly in the first rush of an ambush among the trees.

flacai.name: Village Lads
flacai.description: Peasant lads with pitchforks and scythes, who follow the haiduci for a share of the boyars' gold.

puscasi.name: Long Rifles
puscasi.description: Marksmen with long rifles taken from the boyars' armouries. They never miss a fat target.

calareti_haiduci.name: Mountain Riders
calareti_haiduci.description: Haiduci on swift mountain horses. They strike hard and are gone before the posse arrives.

capitan_haiduc.name: The Haiduc Captain
capitan_haiduc.description: The captain of the greenwood. The braves follow him through fire, for he shares the loot fairly.

ucenici.name: Apprentices
ucenici.description: Scholars of the school beneath the earth. They hurl sparks and hailstones from their staves.

paznici.name: Cave Wardens
paznici.description: Hooded guards of the hidden school. Patient as stone, they hold the line for the sorcerers.

grindinari.name: Hailcallers
grindinari.description: Masters who call the storm. Hail the size of eggs falls wherever they point.

balauri_imblanziti.name: Tamed Wyrms
balauri_imblanziti.description: Dragons raised in the mountain lakes and ridden with iron bridles. They fly over any wall.

solomonar_batran.name: The Elder Solomonar
solomonar_batran.description: The oldest of the solomonari, who has read the book of all the world's secrets.

haiduc_brigands.name: Rebel Peasants
haiduc_brigands.description: Peasants who have taken up axes and cudgels against their lords.

haiduc_marksmen.name: Rebel Hunters
haiduc_marksmen.description: Hunters and poachers with old rifles and bows.

black_army.name: Black Army Foot
black_army.description: The paid regulars of the Hungarian crown, in black harness, with long spears and pavises.

hungarian_knights.name: Hungarian Knights
hungarian_knights.description: Armoured lords of the plains, heavy and proud.

winged_hussars.name: Winged Hussars
winged_hussars.description: Polish lancers with feathered wings on their backs; their charge breaks any line.

janissaries.name: Janissaries
janissaries.description: The Sultan's slave-soldiers, drilled from boyhood, with muskets and sabres.

akinci.name: Akıncı Raiders
akinci.description: Light horsemen who live from plunder, riding ahead of the Sultan's armies.

tatar_riders.name: Tatar Horse Archers
tatar_riders.description: Riders of the steppe who shoot from the saddle and never stand to fight.

fat_frumos.name: Făt-Frumos
fat_frumos.description: The prince born of tears, who rode a fire-eating horse beyond the edge of the world.

greuceanu.name: Greuceanu
greuceanu.description: The hero who won back the sun and the moon from the zmei, with a mace forged in seven years.

zgripturoaica.name: Zgripțuroaica
zgripturoaica.description: The griffin-hag who guards the zmei's hoards; her talons tear through iron.

spanul.name: Spânul
spanul.description: The beardless trickster who serves the zmei, cruel and cunning.

ileana.name: Ileana Cosânzeana
ileana.description: The fairest of all maidens; for her sake no one in the Fae host will run.

zana_zanelor.name: Queen of the Fairies
zana_zanelor.description: Queen of the clearings and the fairy rings, older than the forest.

baba_cloanta.name: Baba Cloanța
baba_cloanta.description: The old witch of the marshes, who knows every spell of the dead.

pricolici.name: The Great Pricolici
pricolici.description: The lord of the werewolves, who runs ahead of the Revenants under the full moon.

iancu_jianu.name: Iancu Jianu
iancu_jianu.description: The boyar's son who turned haiduc. He robs the rich, frees the prisoners and laughs at the posses.

pintea.name: Pintea the Brave
pintea.description: The haiduc of the northern hills, whom no bullet but a silver one could kill.

balaurul_iezer.name: The Lake Dragon
balaurul_iezer.description: The great dragon who sleeps in the mountain lake, waiting for a solomonar to bridle him.

al_treisprezecelea.name: The Thirteenth Scholar
al_treisprezecelea.description: Of every thirteen scholars, one stays with the Devil's school for ever and learns to ride the storm.
